masterpiece, high-end 3D commercial animation style, luxury perfume advertisement, C4D render aesthetic. A stunning young Asian woman with long flowing black hair and warm amber eyes, wearing a sleek red bodysuit and a translucent flowing white silk robe. She holds a glowing square glass perfume bottle with a gold cap, emitting warm sparkling light. Background is a soft dreamy pink with floating gold-rimmed geometric crystals and slowly falling rose petals. Cinematic lighting, soft pink ambient glow, rim lighting highlighting her hair and the bottle edges. Ultra-detailed materials: realistic skin with subsurface scattering, dynamic flowing silk fabric, glossy glass and metal reflections. 8k resolution, ray tracing, shallow depth of field, advertising quality, smooth motion.

3D animated commercial style, C4D render aesthetic. Medium shot. A stunning young Asian woman with long flowing black hair, wearing a red bodysuit and a translucent white silk robe. She holds a glowing square glass perfume bottle with a gold cap. The bottle emits a warm, sparkling light. Soft pink background with floating gold-rimmed geometric crystals and slowly falling rose petals. Camera performs a slow, smooth push-in (dolly forward) towards her face and the perfume bottle. Her hair and the white silk robe flutter gently in a soft breeze. Cinematic lighting, soft pink ambient glow, rim lighting highlighting her hair.Audio: Soft, dreamy synth pad music starts. Gentle wind breeze sound. A subtle magical chime as the perfume bottle glows.
Speech (Soft, confident female voice): "Capture the sparkle of the moment..." 
|
Close-up to medium shot. The woman gently brings the glowing perfume bottle closer to her chest, her eyes looking at it with admiration. As she does, the floating rose petals around her begin to swirl faster, and the gold-rimmed crystals rotate slowly, refracting light. The light from the perfume bottle intensifies, casting a warm glow on her face and the translucent silk robe. Camera performs a slow, elegant orbit (arc shot) around her from left to right, showcasing the 3D depth and the flowing fabric. High fidelity, ray tracing, subsurface scattering on skin.Audio: Music builds up slightly. The sound of glass gently clinking. A magical "whoosh" as the petals swirl.
Speech (Whispering, alluring): "...and let the scent become your signature."
|
Medium wide shot. A sudden, gentle gust of wind blows her long black hair and the white silk robe dramatically and beautifully behind her. She looks directly into the camera lens with a confident, charming smile, holding the perfume bottle up slightly. The perfume bottle emits a final, bright burst of golden light and sparkles. The background crystals shine brightly. Camera slowly pulls back and tilts up slightly, framing her perfectly in the center. The motion gradually slows down into a beautiful slow-motion freeze frame. 8k resolution, masterpiece, advertising quality.Audio: Music reaches a gentle climax with a soft orchestral hit. Stronger wind sound. A final, resonant magical chime.
Speech (Confident, smiling tone): "Bloom for you."

The camera remains static throughout, maintaining a shallow depth of field, which keeps the man in sharp focus while the background is softly blurred, revealing a light-colored wall with white wooden shelving or trim, and a partially open white wooden door on the right. After a brief pause, another short, audible sniff is heard. The man then continues to speak, his voice maintaining the same quality, as he states, "So bad. So bad." He elaborates further, emphasizing his point with a final statement, "This got to be, it's got to be the worst tool I've ever seen."
